mentions.name: Springus
mentions.description: This iOS app suggests outfits based on photos of the user's closet basics and what they already own, positioned as a small morning momentum hack rather than a fashion app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m a remote dev building an iOS app called Springus. You add a few pics / your closet basics, and it suggests outfits based on what you already own. It’s less “fashion app” and more “tiny morning momentum hack.”
